原: I agree that it isn’t easy for. / Young people to find work, …
疑为: I agree that it isn’t easy for young people to find work, …
理由: 一句话在 for 后被句号切断，第47句开头 Young 被误大写；按整句意思分两半译。

原: After you hear a question. / You must choose …
疑为: After you hear a question, you must choose …
理由: 念题说明被句号切成两句；按整句译。

原: …which still accounted for most of the West, over the next 25 years, post offices grew quickly.
疑为: …most of the West. Over the next 25 years, post offices grew quickly.
理由: 两句被逗号连在一起，over the next 25 years 属于后一句；译文用分号分开。

原: …tempted people into the deserts and plains, the post kept them connected.
疑为: …tempted people into the deserts and plains, and the post kept them connected.（或句号分开）
理由: 逗号连接两个独立句；译作“而邮政让他们和外界保持联系”。
第110句是 Blevins，题目里字母颠倒；人名统一译“布莱文斯”。

原: After you hear a question, you must. / Choose the best answer …
疑为: After you hear a question, you must choose the best answer …
理由: 念题说明在 must 后被句号切断；按整句译。

原: Not only have we grown accustomed to getting the information we want instantaneously. / Our attention spans are much shorter.
疑为: Not only have we grown accustomed to …instantaneously, our attention spans are also much shorter.
理由: Not only 倒装句只有前半，后半被句号切到第173句；按“不仅……而且……”译。

原: …our preferred outlet for venting. / About work-related matters, this is an avenue …
疑为: …our preferred outlet for venting about work-related matters; this is an avenue …
理由: about work-related matters 是 venting 的宾语，被句号切到下一句；第199句按“说到工作上的事”译。
